notes.title: Under Attack - Update 14.4
notes.content:
Turrets
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2571eed354ee016068c71572b59231b77d815541.png
For some time, you have requested to add more ways to defend your shop or home. We agree this is an excellent addition to Saleblazers, so we're excited to introduce automatic turrets in this patch!
There are 16 new turrets to research and craft, starting with the meager rock thrower and working up to electric-powered M4 and AWP turrets.
 Mk. I turrets are coal-powered and feature some early-game ranged weapons.
 Mk. II turrets need to be hooked up to a generator and boast more firepower.
 Mk. III turrets require even more electricity but feature the highest-tier firepower in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/752b2b602bdba59151baddb0470a81f53f0c692e.gif

After researching the turrets, you can craft them at the weapon forge. We can't wait to see your turret defense set-ups in the Community Hub screenshots or on our Discord channel!

Defensive Spikes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2820feb7f5719c4d2e60ac9f05fdc0e3aaeb21da.png
We're also introducing Bamboo, Wood, and Carbon Iron spike traps to the research tree to supplement your turret defenses. These spikes can be crafted in the Sawmill and placed around your shop. Enemies will try to run through them but will be forced to slow to walking speed and take damage over time while they do.

The spikes' damage increases as you use better materials to craft them, and the Carbon Iron spike traps can withstand significant damage before breaking.

Nighttime Attacks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e5c8cf0a2d0e92e828382721bf73edd3b05a50db.png
We've added some new nighttime attack mechanics in the Under Attack update. Once the sun goes down, there is a chance for Ghouls to spawn around your location and attack you. These attacks can occur while exploring or in the shop plot, so consider making your way to a defensible location once it starts getting dark. Your new turrets and spike traps should help you keep your shop safe and running overnight, but you can always sleep through the night to avoid the bulk of these attacks.

We plan on adding more depth to the system for attacking shop plots, including more ways to counter these attacks, so we look forward to hearing your feedback on this mechanic. We've been having a good time setting up turret kill zones at our shops for these enemies, so we hope you also find they make the nighttime gameplay more exciting.
Peaceful Night Setting
We know that some players aren't fans of being attacked at the shop and would prefer to continue shopkeeping in peace, so we have added a Peaceful Night lobby configuration setting that will allow you to turn off these new attacks, as well as the existing Watcher Ghoul spawns around the shop plots. Regular enemies can still chase you to the shop, but we hope this will also be a good first step towards accommodating more peaceful gameplay.

Clothing Dye Station
We heard you wanted some more control over the color of your clothing and general appearance. The first step toward that goal is the Clothing Dye Station. With this workbench, you can input a piece of clothing and some clothing dye and select which colorway you want to apply to that item. After researching the dye station, you can craft clothing dye in your crafting table using coffee beans, plant fiber, seaweed, coal, or ink.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f2320fcc36a74c24ad470a2f5de540485cdcf66d.png

Steam Spring Sale and Pre-Sale Early Supporter Bonuses
We're working on getting Saleblazers out to as many people as possible to get more shops up and running, more worlds to invade, more friends to build the North Star with, and more resources to continue developing toward our 1.0 release.

To reach more players, we're excited to announce we will be participating in the Steam Spring sale later this week!

However, we want to ensure that all of our players who have already supported us get a proper thank you, as we couldn't be where we are today without you. So, anyone who purchased or activated the game before 03/14/2024 will unlock some exclusive items.
 Gold Nameplate and Airstrafer Insignia
 Gold Airstrafer Jacket Colorway
 Black and Gold Airstrafer Apron Colorway
 Supporter Medallion
 Black and Gold Airstrafer Wallpaper

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4ca9053a733532ab8012096730c6e2909e40791e.png
This is the perfect opportunity to try out the new Clothing Dye Bench. Your exclusive colorways will be available when you dye an apron or any of the Airstrafer jackets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5fca88eddc5f6cc77270060e9c9c2f2812515425.png
You can swap between the gold nameplate and the normal white one from the ESC menu using these arrows.

The Traveler will also have a special message from us to you, so head over to Invasion Island and chat with him when you can.

The rewards and the Traveler's message can be claimed at any time if your purchase or activation date meets the requirements, so there is no rush to claim it.
We are hoping to do more time-gated colorways and nameplates like this for other big moments like our 1.0 release and potentially as achievement unlocks, so let us know what you think of them.

Hold to Pick Up Containers and Large Items
By popular demand, you now have to hold down the pickup button for containers and large items so that you don't accidentally pick them up and spill their contents everywhere.

 Items will still spill out when picked up. This change only makes accidental pickups less common. It's also a much-needed balance change to prevent spam throwing large items to ragdoll people.

Thank you to everyone who has brought up this suggestion and been part of discussions surrounding it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ec70fe26c5aaf9775244c86fd66e7082e2ced9ad.gif

New Quarry Quest
You can now find a small camp of refugees south of the quarry. Talk to them to start a new quest in the area where you can free some Ronin captives from the mines.

The reward for this quest is[spoiler]the new first NPC Summon item since the License to Sell update introduced the summon walkie-talkies[/spoiler]. We think it's pretty fun and look forward to seeing you try it out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/458e642d95156136948c18919b3003ed597e6f0c.png
As a part of implementing this quest, we also optimized the quarry and redid some of the paths and ziplines to make it more fun to traverse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/781307ecd9cf833521cffb402eefc246fefe2019.png
We believe this quest fills out this part of the world more and adds some goals for the quarry area, which was previously more of a sandbox dungeon zone. We hope you enjoy it!

Boiling Cups and Bowls of Water
As another survival tool to handle dehydration, you can now use your campfire or stove to boil dirty or salt water collected in cups or bowls to make it safe to drink.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d56a59215b0d02362bc6fd5bcf778217da25e29d.png
Experimental Outpost Clearing and Raid System

We're working on a new feature to make outposts more fun to find, explore, and clear out. Outposts will have a name, and the faction that owns them will be displayed when you enter. A cleared percentage bar will display your progress as you fight the enemies inside. An additional reward will spawn once you defeat all the enemies in an outpost. Currently, this reward will be a chest of items based on the outpost. Once cleared, the Outpost UI will display the time until the outpost resets and can be cleared again.
Every time you clear an outpost, you risk triggering a retaliation attack from the faction that owns it.

We think this clarity and additional rewards make outposts more fun to discover and make farming outpost loot clearer and more rewarding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e814b27dca0a965f69c87e61089807448f06e057.png
So far, we have only made this experimental feature live on a few outposts for you to try out. You can try this mechanic at the following outposts near the starting area:

 Ruins Overlook Outpost

notes.title: Loot Goblin - Update 14.3
notes.content:
In this patch, we're unleashing everyone's inner loot goblin.

We hope that with all these changes you'll have a more satisfying time looting and mass-selling items.

This patch is quite big and we didn't write about everything that we did, so read the full patch notes at the bottom for all the details!

Mantling
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1699a041a7167301db19a21a46c6bb89c4602383.gif

You can now perform a small mantle by jumping and moving towards ledges. This will cost a little bit of stamina, so be careful!

Loot placed in high locations will no longer be safe from all you loot goblins out there.

Inventory Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/8ae52465851593cfda4a7f35ecedc0e9cf843c1e.png
Better Inventory UX
We've improved and condensed inventory slot UI quite a bit, which will allow you to see more items at once, access your equipment, and have an easier time moving items around.

Increased Inventory Slots and Upgrades
After hearing and watching lots of feedback, we've also increased the starting amount of slots from 15 to 32 with even more Ambrosia upgrades in store. By unlocking all of Ambrosia's upgrades, you'll have 56 inventory slots to accommodate all your looting needs. We want you to loot to your heart's content! 

Remember: you can hold shift to quick swap items between containers.

Scrap All Button on Containers
There's also a new "Scrap All" button that will instantly scrap all scrappable items, making scrap and ammo runs much more convenient and fun for all loot goblins out there. This has been a highly requested feature since launch, and it turned out really fun to implement, so thank you for all the feedback!

Increased Container Inventories
To match all your newfound inventory space, we've rebalanced most of the unlockable containers to have more slots so you can better organize and store items in your shop or base. Our new UI makes accessing inventories with more slots smoother, allowing us to make this change. We also introduced some more early-game storage containers into the research tree to make organizing your initial shops more enjoyable.

 Bamboo Storage Box now has 16 slots.
 Added Wooden Storage Box with 22 slots.
 Added Scrap Metal Storage Box with 32 slots.
 Wooden Crate now has 24 slots.
 Tall Wooden Crate now has 40 slots.
 Carbon Iron Crate now has 48 slots.
 Tall Carbon Iron Crate now has 64 slots.

x999 Ammo Stacks
We've unlocked all ammo items to be able to stack up to 999 per slot.

Before, you'd be limited to carrying varying ranges of 15-120 stacks of different ammo types. We found it more fun only to have to dedicate one inventory slot to each ammo type.

Day Night Cycle Balancing
We've increased the amount of time for an in-game hour from 60 seconds to 90 seconds, increased the visibility of nighttime a bit, and rebalanced crafting recipe availability to allow for lighting options earlier on.

This should give loot goblins a better chance to grab a few more things before retiring to the shop for the night.

Enhanced ESC Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d0dd6243aa3a20bb9f2f21a5a6df544f285ab235.png
The ESC menu has been improved with more detailed information about your stats in one place.

Immersion Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/09dcfd0344dbeb91b50acde4b4da737131778a36.png
We've also made several changes in the name of immersion this patch. You can read the full details down below, but here are some of our favorites:

Citizen NPC Factions
Citizens throughout the Island now have their own unique factions and relationships to themselves and other factions. 

Athletes are friendly to Chefs, Fishermen are friendly to Farmers, Gamers are friendly to College Students, and so on. 

We've also made more factions neutral to each other instead of being friendly, so you should see brawls occur more often and witness NPCs teaming up.

NPCs Sleeping in Beds at Night and Various Villager NPC Improvements
Villagers will now sleep in beds at night. You should see overall improvements and optimizations to the day-night cycles for villagers in all the major settlements.

"Less is More" Pass on SFX, VFX, and UI
SFX and VFX across the board have been toned down for an overall more enjoyable experience that lets you be more in the moment. Some examples are kill FX, container open sounds, and interaction FX/UI.

Hit Reaction Animations
You'll be able to see enemies reacting to non-hitstun type damage sources now.

Fewer "Ouch" Voice Lines
Instead of playing an "ouch" every time an NPC is damaged, they only play them periodically. It's pretty simple, but it goes a long way in immersing yourself in the game. A notable scenario was when an NPC was on fire -- they'd keep spamming voice lines.

Music Tweaks
It should feel less jarring to rapidly enter and exit combat with a more gradual transition, and some tracks have been shifted around to better match the vibe of the area.

Better "Caught Stealing" Behavior
NPCs will now name the crime that they caught you committing (theft, vandalism) and name the actual item. They'll also return every item you stole and into any valid containers.

Better Village Police AI
The police in villages should be more in tune with crimes committed nearby now.

Better Bullet Trails
Trails from bullets linger for longer in the air to better communicate where they originated from and also increase the intensity of firefights.

UI Button Prompt Visibility Option
If you want to enable or disable button prompts (such as the one at the bottom left of the screen), there's now an option for it. By default, this is set to "minimal".

Improved Game Areas
We've heavily modified several areas in the game to improve level design, add new encounters, add additional runes, fix minor issues, and further optimize the game, especially for lower-end machines. 
There's too much to write about here, so we'll just put a star ⭐ on the ones that have more changes.

⭐Areas From Pop Pop's Shop Shop to Pop Pop's House
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/cf89b64af35e33daa22c96f06f1d9b8e9222214a.png

⭐Areas around Pop Pop's House

Pippo's Bakery
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c3a27d9c0a33d95457dc2fe121d9af5add1dd35b.png

Better Gameplay Simulation During Sleep
When you sleep, the following is now simulated:

 Employee Activity
 Crafting Items
 Customer Activity

That means you'll be able to make money while sleeping in your shop instead of having to leave and come back.

Detailed Shop Summary When Returning to a Shop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c0525fcfc59830ea32d37c481668484fa4f045db.png

When returning to a shop after being away for a while, you'll now see a satisfying summary of what your shop did as a chat message. It lists information about items gathered, crafted, and sold, as well as employee wage cost details. At the end, it'll print out a neat net profit amount for you.

Prologue Improvements
We've simplified the prologue's Survival Training and added a way to skip Survival Training altogether by interacting with the Cafeteria door. 

We originally removed the prologue level because it was too long. With these flow improvements, the prologue is now the default way to start playing Saleblazers again!

Loot Container Respawn Timers
In a previous patch, we fixed an issue where loot inside containers was respawning every time that container loaded in. A side effect was that containers no longer respawned their loot at all. So, for our loot goblin patch, we added timers for loot respawns so you can plan reoccurring run-throughs of areas and get fresh loot each time.

 Common chests respawn after 18 hours.
 Crates and barrels respawn after 24 hours.
 Uncommon chests respawn after 24 hours.
 Rare chests respawn after 36 hours.
 Ammo crates respawn after 48 hours.

If you deposit new items into these containers, new loot will skip the slots you leave it in.

Death Box Treasures Quest Overhaul
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d710adfc0c82ffc5137701150bc685861c4a5ba1.png
We received some reports that there were some issues with this quest. We decided to do a significant overhaul to remedy them, updating many aspects of the quest.

You can now find Miyuki in Kazai Settlement to experience this grave-robbing side adventure, and we've added Coal Tycoon Sylvester Friedamp to the Kazai Village Inn, where there's another piece of the quest to discover. We hope you enjoy it!

Significant Optimization to Killing Enemies and PIcking Up Items
We noticed that on some computers, you'd experience a huge CPU-based FPS loss every time you killed an enemy or picked something up (especially items from Salvage Crates or trees). This is now fixed with a few reworks on our end!

More Aggressive Outlaw Enemies
Outlaws will be more aggressive, have ranged weapons more often than melee weapons, and engage you at farther distances for a more intense experience. In exchange, we've added more ammo drops to Outlaws for you to loot!

Upcoming Patches
In the next few patches, we'll be focusing on improving more game areas, adding new defensive items, and ramping up the survival aspects of the game. You'll want to loot as much as you can to prepare for these future patches, as we'll be introducing new challenges!

notes.title: Hotfix v0.14.2.3 - Intel Iris Xe GPU Red Screen Fix
notes.content:
Intel Iris Xe GPU Red Screen Fix
If you've experienced a red and white screen on an Intel Xe chip, this should now be fixed. 

If you're curious, it's just because our auto exposure render feature had an incompatible fragment shader that didn't run on the Intel Xe GPU.

We bought an Intel i7-1255U 1.7GHz + Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics laptop to track down this tricky bug. Our laptop manages around 60-70FPS in the starting area in Potato mode free of any red screen issues!

We've also added a few more options to the graphics setting (post process and auto exposure) which should give even more FPS for any low end gamers out there!

➡️ Changes

 Updated several footstep FX for better immersion
 Sleeping now clears and refreshes spawned enemies
 Changed Kazai Village area with some new runes and paths
 Removed fences from the ranch for upcoming night gameplay balance
 Updated Ambient Occlusion technique to improve visuals


⚙️ Optimizations

 Added auto exposure graphics setting to turn it off for Potato mode

🛠️ General Fixes

 Fixed red and white screens on Intel Xe chips due to incompatible fragment auto exposure shader

notes.title: Dark Nights - Update 14.2
notes.content:
Night Terrors
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/813dd5e31c5ae84e5c5ecd83a004f87b9d23dff9.png
Last patch we added new terrifying cultist enemy types. Now, we're making night time even scarier. 

At around midnight in-game all music stops playing, the world falls under extreme darkness, Bellcoats go insane, and cultists begin roaming the lands in larger quantities.

To account for this, we've made Torches a 99-stack item type to fulfill all your early game pre-electricity lighting needs. 

(Note: If you played on February 8th or 9th, we've since updated the lighting to be a little brighter. You played part of this patch early! Also, we'll be continuously tweaking the day/night mechanics in the coming patches.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a63e7eb5b98015ca9851d5b36c4a2f8a388e3207.png
The Waist Light is also much stronger now and will rotate towards your view direction. 

If you want to go into an experimental first person mode like in this screenshot above, you can press F1.

Good luck! We'll be adding even more midnight threats in the coming months, so it might be wise for you to invest in acquiring a Clock. 

Don't forget, you can always safely skip the night by sleeping in a bed. At least for now...

Global Lighting Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2d9f6d7c27b28cbffb55c12b61a36e9abfa218f2.png
We've changed how the game looks throughout the day for a less contrasted, more balanced look. 

This also smooths out light attenuation, so you'll be able to light larger swaths with fewer light sources. You can see this in the paper lanterns in the image above!

Render Distance Graphics Setting
Render distance is now an option under the Visuals section. You can turn this down if your computer doesn't have a strong GPU.

Optional Resolution Upscaling
We had some pretty crazy upscaling combined with lowered render scale this whole time which made the whole game look rather muddy in exchange for reduced GPU load.

In this patch, we've reset render scale to 100% and added an option to toggle upscaling under the Visuals settings so that you can choose to enable or disable this yourself.

Upscaling will now be off by default. If you want to have the same settings that you had before, just lower your render scale to 0.8 and turn on upscaling. However, this patch features many optimizations so you shouldn't need this as much anymore!

If you want the old behavior back for possible reduced GPU load, you'll have to do the following:
- Set Render Scaling to something low, like 0.5 to 0.8
- Set Upscaling Method to FidelityFX 1.0

Other games normally reduce render scale automatically.

CPU and GPU Optimizations
Check out the list of optimizations down below for a full list of improvements.

Misc. Gameplay and Art Changes
Read the full patch notes below. We've made some changes throughout the game to make it feel more dynamic, immersive, and fun.

 Previously, enemies would sometimes rush into your base. Now they will respect line of sight more, so close your doors to be safe!

notes.title: Update 14.1 - Remember to Hydrate!
notes.content:
Minor Update 14.1 is here! Here's a summary of this patch:

 New Automated Shop Hours
 New Quest
 New Human Cage and Cursed Human Cage Items/Enemies
 Employee System QoL features
 Camera Rework
 Gunplay Polish
 Miscellaneous Improvements and Fixes


Automated Shop Hours
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f1530973c82499ee21225618dbed135718d0d9aa.jpg

You can now set when your shop automatically opens and closes to better automate your shops alongside your employees.

Don't want to stop by each of your shops at 6 am to reopen for the day and again at 10 pm to close for the night? Now you can set it all up in advance and let the open close sign handle it.

You can set up your automated store hours on the open close sign or sync them from your total employee hours if you want the store to match your default employee work schedule.

Wanting automated shop hours was a big piece of feedback we heard over on our Discord (https://discord.gg/Saleblazers) and Steam Forums. Thank you very much for bringing this up!

New Hydration NPC Questline
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d9471d00c0a00230cfba1f1d6d6ee599bd32fa99.jpg

Talk to May Porter to start this quest. You'll find her all throughout the map, and a good starter spot to check is in front of Pop Pop's house!

New Human Cage Cultist Enemies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a0f7abb35293961301a37520a95fee92a101e6c8.png

Some Cultists are now equipped with a new item that allows them to capture you for a set duration. Watch out for a Cultist variant that only moves when you don't look...

Reworked Smoother Camera Code
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/87402f558cd5bff3048bcb718540ee624c2c752a.gif

Previously, the player camera would collide with surrounding obstacles fairly frequently (especially through doorways) and move the camera in directions that felt unpredictable. There'd also be situations where your camera flickered in and out rapidly.

In this patch, we've reworked the camera raycasting code. It's much more lenient now, moves more smoothly, and has brand new interpolation behavior. It's somewhat subtle, but you'll really feel the difference in close quarters.

New Gun Accuracy Crosshair Indicator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ec534ed0eaf9421624797a34af829c13b10fd340.gif

In Saleblazers, gun accuracy is determined by the type of gun, your movement speed, and how far you've aimed down sights (right click). 

This information isn't intuitive, so we've added a dynamic crosshair that reflects your gun's current accuracy levels.

 Recoil Smoothing, Bullet Hole Decals, and Impact VFX
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/11a9c63ed2b22e77bf14fa24e90b88b0e2bc5019.gif

Recoil has been reworked to feel smoother to make it more fun to control. In addition, shooting walls and items now leaves bullet holes with updated bullet impact VFX. 

Gunfights should feel a lot more grounded and enjoyable with these changes!

New Punch Combo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/98f05aaa8f69626ae4ad80a105d15e83fa2c0c3e.gif

The previous punch combo didn't carry you very far, and was very hard to block or dodge when NPCs used it on you.

This one should telegraph the attack a lot better! We've increased the damage of punches to compensate for the slower attack.

Employee Priorities by Shift
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c87b571a051947fb3828f826614f1ca9f8d772d4.png

Along with the automated shop hours, you can now set an employee's work priority by shift, giving you more control than ever over how they work. You can configure the override priorities for each shift in the work schedules page of the employee management screen. 

With these settings, an overnight employee can focus on crafting and restocking while your shop is closed. Once the shop opens in the morning, you can have that same employee stop crafting altogether and focus on haggling. 

You can do a lot with these priority overrides, so we look forward to seeing all of your clever automated shop setups.

Employee Management Quality of Life
Managing employees has a little bit more clarity with this update. Employee names are highlighted in the management screen when they are working or training so you can see at a glance which employees are currently on shift or away for training.

You can also copy and paste work schedules between employees to easily organize your workforce into matching shifts.

(Preview) Upcoming Terrain Map Updates for Optimization and Gameplay
We're in the process of turning rock mesh heavy sections of the map from this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0ba66be0bc6490415993b208047198aeea87d3e8.png

Into this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d483f699da5b6abd5a908b5ba5cd37565ac67c5d.png

The primary reason for this is to improve performance by reducing vertex count, but this change also gives the benefits of a cleaner art style and clearer level design.

We'll be pushing these changes periodically throughout future patches, so we wanted to give you all a heads up in advance.

We're also smoothing out terrain for another new gameplay mechanic... but we'll reveal what it is in a future patch!

notes.title: Valheim meets Fortnite as sandbox shopkeeping RPG launches big update
notes.content:
Take the open-world combat and building of Fortnite - and its recent companion Lego Fortnite - and mix in the survival and crafting elements of games like Valheim and Minecraft. Then sprinkle in a little of that Stardew Valley community magic, and you've baked a Saleblazers cake. This indie sandbox RPG from developer Airstrafe Interactive is all about selling goods, and it's up to you whether you want to run a cozy corner shop or a grand retail empire - but you'll need to get out there and procure the goods for yourself.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Update 14.0 - License to Sell
notes.content:
To celebrate Steam Capitalism and Economy Fest 2024, we're launching Update 14.0 - License to Sell with some all-new content that'll challenge both your shopkeeping and combat skills at the same time.

[previewyoutube=OeSDfem9DoM;full][/previewyoutube]
As always, thank you for leaving feedback on the Steam forums and https://discord.gg/Saleblazers. We hope you'll all have a great start to a new year!

New Desert Shop Plot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9eac2ff4437a7b53d16c3a3e86f4e48e2e76d98c.png
In this patch, we've added a Decommissioned Shop Plot in the Desert to the northeast of the Canyon. All throughout the day, waves of cultists relentlessly attack any unfortunate soul who happens to be in the area.

In addition, if you drop to 0 stars you'll lose everything within the plot bounds. It's all or nothing in the desert!

Desert Shop Plot Questline
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/76783098b23967115ecc800300c373b7a699775d.png
The government needs your help in revitalizing the desert and protecting the desert shop plot's customers from roving bands of cultists. 

Take on the challenge and build a 5-star shop from nothing while surviving against waves of cultists in a harsh desert environment. 

When you're ready, speak to Inspector Gunther at the new desert shop plot!

New Carbon Iron Building Pieces for Taller Buildings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/97109633e04223927e224efdcc26b21b6900e2f1.png
You can now build taller structures with all-new Stone and Carbon Iron building pieces.

The sawmill has also become more of a roleplayer for construction as you will now use it to cut planks, stone bricks, and carbon iron bars into smaller cut versions for your building pieces. These cut versions of processed materials are an important change to balance the resource costs of the new beams. We also hope it makes using the existing castle and coastal building sets less of a resource grind.

It might be helpful to acquire a Glider before experimenting with taller structures!

Expanded Employee Table Unlocks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0c6caf125329b0996d8849a80e89b5e31d4447db.png
We've added a few more lines to the Employee Table's unlock tab. You'll be able to increase your employee capacity count, train several employees at the same time, and unlock more training courses.

One of the biggest pieces of feedback we've heard about larger shops is that 8 employees sometimes isn't enough. We hope that with these new unlocks, which will allow you to have up to 16 employees at once, you can run massive shops more efficiently and reach your automation goals.

If you already have employees, you'll need to unlock these new nodes to hire more, but you'll keep your existing employees.

NPC Summons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4f7f67483ef85036de37016172f698546b0c5631.png
We've added walkie talkies throughout the game that, upon use, will summon NPCs to your location. Sometimes they're friendly... and sometimes they aren't.

If you've already completed Mayor Yori's questline, talk to him for the first one of these.

Carbon Iron Crates
We've also seen feedback about wanting better late-game item storage options. Our first step for improving this is the introduction of short and tall carbon iron crates to the research tree. These crates can hold 22 and 28 items and boast high HP to keep them safe.

notes.title: Small Patch to v0.13.1.0
notes.content:
Please restart Steam to ensure you have the latest patch! The build number will not increment this time.

This small patch brings more viability to building facilities in your Plot area, and improves customer queue behavior.

Customers Can Leave Queues to Fulfill Needs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/802d9a39c27f50bc7077ab39f943ae8822a7b43a.gif

When in line, customers can now leave if their needs drop low enough. 

This means having a low patience customer doesn't spell the end for your shop's star rating, which will make larger shops much more viable.

Just make sure there are enough amenities around! 

With this change, customers hanging out in the Plot areas will be able to walk around and use facilities.

To set a floor to a Plot type, press E to cycle through a floor's type with a Bamboo Construction Hammer equipped.

Customers Distribute More Evenly Across Queues
Previously, customers would overwhelmingly favor one cash register which would make passing Star Promotion waves very difficult.

Now, customers will spread themselves across multiple nearby registers.

More Plot Floors
We've also added the ability for more floors and stairs to be Plot types. This means you'll be able to build better looking Plot areas instead of using dirt paths everywhere.

Have fun!

notes.title: Minor Update v0.13.1.0
notes.content:
Read up on Update 13, where we made things a lot harder: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1419850/view/3878224909275599112

Since Update 13, we made a few hotfixes (v0.13.0.0 - v0.13.0.5) to resolve several new bugs that were introduced. Thank you very much for the save files you all sent in -- we were able to push out hotfixes very quickly because of them.

Now, we have some breathing room and can focus on iterating on the feedback received from the Steam forums and https://discord.gg/Saleblazers.


Here's a minor update that brings polish changes, gameplay balance, and misc. fixes. Enjoy!

🔫Improved Gunplay
This patch fixes a few issues with our gunplay.

☀️Better Bullet Visuals
Bullet VFX has been improved to better reflect the actual 1:1 hitbox of the projectile.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/87f4af4faa99080294bd0b56550cc72875093f51.gif

🌐Improved Client Gun Netcode
This patch considerably improves the responsiveness for shooting guns when you are connected to someone else's server. It also improves it by 1 frame for the host.

Previously there'd be a huge delay when shooting/aiming/reloading as a client, which made it difficult to make high APM plays as it delayed reloads and shot cooldowns.

Try it out! You should be able to do 360 quick scopes much easier now as a client.

💢Improved Hitboxes on Many Enemies
Previously, if you landed a hit on a limb instead of the capsule of an enemy it wouldn't count as a hit. This is what caused you to "miss" on Chickens, Gulpers, Crabs, etc. even though you clearly landed a clean hit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/304248be7bbe4f5ec858772c9b12b5cc7ad07603.gif

This is now fixed. See? It wasn't your aim.

🤺Slightly More Lenient Melee Hitboxes
We've tweaked some of the melee code and data to reduce the chance of an attack slipping by an enemy.

🏪Shopkeeping Balance Changes
In this patch, we've ironed out several shopkeeping mechanics to make the experience overall more enjoyable. 

Our goal is to make you feel in control of your shop as much as we can, by providing you options to deal with situations and more availability to information of what's going on in your shop.

⌛Patience Balance Changes
We've played a lot of your shops, and we've seen that they can get pretty large with patience getting in the way in an unfun manner. 

In this patch, a customer's patience will now regenerate when they are first admitted into the shop. 

If all needs are high enough, their patience will slowly recover. 

You'll still have to plan out your shop carefully, but you should no longer be punished for having a gigantic shop.

🎲Better Haggling Percentage Chance
Haggling percentage chances have been improved, so go ahead and squeeze out those extra dollars from your customers!


📖Customer Item Context
We've added better visual feedback for what your customers are doing in your shop so that you can tell what's going on at a quick glance. 

Customers will:

 Put away their existing items when they enter your shop plot
 Switch to the item they just picked up from a display
 Switch to the item they're trying to buy during the haggling minigame

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e5cba461e32995a78c2511dbf0fc39b58b23141c.png

🚽Updated Needs UI and Needs Balancing
The Needs UI has been updated for better visual clarity. 

We've also made a few adjustments to needs stats so that not everyone has to go to the bathroom the moment they enter your shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/8421515477dc19619ca5299f41bd365f2e38b138.png

🛒Updated Haggling UI
Traffic now updates alongside your customer flow upgrades, instead of just showing you traffic based on the time of day. The more customer flow upgrades you acquire, the more arrows you'll have!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c46283313eb279b9ef7f04f95fd181210209e975.png

📹Camera Stutter Fixes
We're excited to announce that the weird camera stutter when you enter/exit dialogue is finally gone for most interactions. With that, we're able to add in better transitions for dialogue. We've identified fixes for the final few cases, and will push a follow-up hotfix shortly.

You should notice a big difference this patch that'll make gameplay feel much smoother and easier on the eyes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/df87a01e61c9500c6acf0ea79891caf17c8974c4.gif

🤖More AI Fixes
This patch will include various AI fixes that should round out the overall shopkeeping experience. Hopefully this is the last of the fixes required for a good time, but we'll be on the lookout.

Thank you to all the players who sent in their save files. With them, we've managed to track down a lot of bugs in the last few hotfixes in a relatively short timespan.

Final Words
Apologies for the rough start of Update 13. It can be very frustrating to lose your shop to the government, and especially so if it was out of your control due to bugs. 

We hope that you'll be able to properly enjoy higher shopkeeping stakes now and we will continue to monitor the situation for any issues that arise.

Have fun, shopkeepers!

- e Zinc

notes.title: Update 13.0 - More Challenging Shopkeeping
notes.content:
Welcome to Part One of our shopkeeping changes. 

[previewyoutube=IHF35bg7hs8;full][/previewyoutube]

This patch is designed to bring a tougher challenge and push the limits of a seasoned shopkeeper's skillset.

Try and see if you can build a 5-star shop in this new update! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We appreciate any and all on the Steam forums or https://discord.gg/Saleblazers so that we can continue to iterate on shopkeeping in the coming patches. 

Starting over in a new shop plot to check out all the new changes is recommended!

❌Losing Your Shop at 0 Star Rating
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1dc96745055d11578178d7f07819b2b776b1c9e7.png

In this patch, if you reach a shop Star Rating of 0, the government will shut down your shop and seize your property. You will be unable to build inside the plot bounds and can no longer run the shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b1beabab2f35d2031c52cdd8d4b3de7e275e7c86.png

To get the shop back, you'll have to talk to Inspector Farley and convince him to return it to you! Maybe Pop Pop will know what to do...

This one might be a bit controversial, but consequences can be pretty fun in games! If you don't like this, you can also turn this feature off in the lobby settings.

👍👎Thumbs Up/Down Reviews
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/30118f1ab300441b67c272d97c867d1023d46558.png

Instead of leaving a review of 0-5 stars, customers will now leave reviews of single/double thumbs up or down. All factors towards a review have been rebalanced for a more challenging experience.

The thumbs rating will also physically show over their head in-game to give a better overview of what's happening in your shop.

⭐Star Rating Overhaul
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/12b716757caf82e1da1091b7616f91c01e3aec30.png

Customers' thumbs up and down ratings will affect the Star Rating in quarterly increments. You'll see the star UI flash when you're close to gaining or losing a quarter star!

Each Star Rating level has different thresholds for how much a thumbs up or down affects the Star Rating. The higher you go, the harder it is to maintain or gain in Star Rating.

Since we've significantly changed how the Star Ratings work, we'll reset your shop to half a star. Don't worry -- you didn't lose anything. Before, stars didn't do much and you could get 5 stars in 2 minutes.

🛒Closing Shop No Longer Kicks Customers Out
Because of the new Star Rating changes, closing the shop will allow the customers in the shop to continue browsing but prevent new customers from entering the shop.

🧑‍🏫Star Promotion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/89eb18dedf67656f1221bf8f37f5af19a186ce5e.png

After gaining a full star you'll enter "Star Promotion" mode, where you'll have to serve a group of new VIP customers (marked by stars above their heads) to move on to the next star. 

Successfully completing the promotion gains you access to faster customer flow and new customer types.

We hope you have as much fun as we did when we were testing these promotions. Good luck -- it'll be a real challenge to get to 5 stars, but we know you can do it!

🧑‍🏭Expanded Employee Systems

We're planning on adding more needs and items for employees later on, but we'll be monitoring how this plays out first.

👨‍💼Employee Skill Unlocks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2e26fd2a0f2c9cd498dc4f0bd73faea947ce7b41.png

In this patch, you'll start out with only Cleaning employees and will have to unlock more types in the Employee Table. If we add more types of employees later on, they'll all be accessible through this skill tree.

🪑Employee Needs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/106c78bd83065991980610da0dbe87736f88b13a.png

Employees now have Morale, Comfort, and Energy bars that you have to tend to. Low Comfort and Energy lowers Morale, which will cause them to stop working.

To raise Comfort, you'll need to build chairs throughout your shop just as you do for your customers. As for Energy, you can tell them to take a break or assign shorter shifts. 

📚Employee Training
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0c6648575b706e6fece78bd416b532cd611a11c2.png

You can now train employees to improve their skills, comfort, and energy. They'll leave the shop when sent to training, so be prepared to take over for your employee while they're away.

😨Employee Fight or Flight Reactions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/48d770d51fed9f0f4917c977a52edc0a76ea9f8e.png

Employees will now fight or flee if spooked, just like customers. We really want to make employees feel a lot more alive, so this will be the first of many new behaviors for them.

🏃‍♂️Customer Flow and Shop Capacity Rework

Previously, shop capacity and customer flow were linked to the level of your shop. This wasn't ideal, since it didn't feel rewarding or responsive to how you ran your shop.

🏃‍♂️Customer Flow Increases With Shop Star Rating
We've changed customer flow to increase based on your shop's Star Rating - as you gain stars, you'll see more customers coming to visit your shop. 

🏃‍♂️Increased Customer Flow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/12a8330ae9254db97c2bd04aff7ea0edb5c7f717.png

Base customer flow values have been increased across the board and the algorithm for spawning customers has been changed, so you'll see a lot more customers lining up even without any shop policy upgrades.

🏃‍♂️More Customer Flow and New Shop Capacity Shop Policy Upgrades

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/6f6fd9d1fda8ba07d8e0487e79cb26e99f09cc56.png

We've added shop capacity upgrades to the shop policy tree and added lots of new customer flow nodes. It's up to you to choose whether you want to run a bustling shop or cozy boutique!

If you prefer to run a personalized boutique, we've also added nodes that reduce the amount of flow you receive!

With these changes, we aim to open up the potential for a lot of different shop builds.

Conclusion
Thanks for reading the patch notes. We hope you enjoy these new changes! There'll be more to come soon.

notes.title: Update 12 v3 - Shopkeeping Stability

We've now officially shifted our focus to polishing, balancing, and adding more features to shopkeeping.

This patch brings a total refactor of a lot of AI, along with additional tweaks to make shopkeeping more consistently fun. 

We have a larger shopkeeping patch in the works, so keep an eye out for that soon!

📜v0.12.3 Changelog

⭐New

 Crouching will now hide the player name that hovers over the player's head, so that players can sneak up on other players... 👀

🏪 Shopkeeping Changes

 There should now be a cool new track that plays when you hit 5 stars in your shop!
 Added ability for customers to queue up at ATMs
 Refactored AI pathfinding for more consistent results and removal of some duplicate calls
 When an employee is not performing any task, they are not allowed on generic tag and will try warp to closest shop plot position, which will prevent them stuck on roof

➡️ Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e74f004ce576eeab1cca2c8e0f41a18801c3ecf1.gif

 Refactored how items are saved to chunks for better performance and consistency

Patch Title Naming Convention
You also may have noticed that our patch title has changed from the usual 0.12.3 to "Update 12 v.3". 

This is to simplify and streamline the patch numbers better, especially once we cross the 3 digit threshold as we plan to have a lot of patches.

notes.title: Minor Update 0.12.26 - Expanded Inventory Space
notes.content:
📖 Updated list of priorities for the development team:
[olist]
 Shopkeeping Gameplay
 Bugs
 RAM Optimization
 New Content
[/olist]

🎒More Inventory Slots!
We noticed that players were forced to choose between items and return to their shop a more frequently than we'd like, cutting into shopkeeping flow. 

The small maximum hotbar size of 6 also made it difficult for players to use a large variety of items when shopkeeping or farming.

We're always looking to make the process of shopkeeping as fun and smooth as possible, so after careful deliberation we've decided to:

 Increase starting inventory slot size from 12 -> 15
 Increase hotkey inventory slot size from 6 -> 9
 Add more inventory size expansions to Ambrosia, also essentially lowering rune costs for earlier upgrades

🪨Updated Rock Shader
We've updated the rock shader so that they look a lot better both when up close and far away. There's a lot of rocks all over the game, so you should notice a significant improvement in overall visual fidelity!

notes.title: Minor Update 0.12.24 - 15 New Rune Race Minigames!
notes.content:
🏃15 New Rune Race Minigames
New runes are coming to the Island in the form of timed races! Can you reach all of the checkpoints before time is up?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0c81359497c7017c318e37fcb11a5e8e27a241a4.png

We're introducing a new mini-game to Saleblazers this week with Rune Races. Throughout the map, you can now find runes protected by energy barriers, which can be earned by entering the runic circle to start the race and then hitting all the checkpoints before time runs out. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/373d186d63e9347da3947ad9355244e4ebb4007f.gif

These races can be short sprints through a riverbed, longer treks across an area, and even golf cart challenges. Each player in a server can complete a Rune Race on their own and earn the associated rune.

We're starting with fifteen races to discover and complete and will add more soon!

🤺More Consistent Melee Combat
In this patch, we made a few changes to make combat more consistent based on a lot of feedback we received.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0a28ced3fbec4624cd47ef002e776f96a09d91d3.gif

[olist]
 Lunging towards an enemy will disable animation-based root motion, to reduce likelihood of sliding past an enemy
 Adjusted several weapon movesets to combo better
 Adjusted hurtbox timings of several moves
 Increased hitstun values of some items
 Reworked medium box moveset (cash register, chair) by swapping the heavy attack and last normal hit for a more consistent combo
 Changed hit reaction animations so enemies don't slide around as much when they are hit
[/olist]

Let us know how you feel over at https://discord.gg/Saleblazers or on the Steam forums!

⚙️More RAM Optimizations
Main Menu: 4.3GB -> 3-3.5GB
Island: 8.6GB -> 4-5.5GB !!!

A big focus this last week has been to reduce the amount of RAM the game uses, which should increase FPS and allow more people to enjoy the game on weaker machines. We've made great strides so far, and will continue to work on this!

notes.content:
📜 Update 0.11 Summary

 Rework to nav mesh generation system, solving several causes of customers and employees being stuck.
 Rework to inventory save/load code, to optimize load times and to solve several inventory load issues
 Added ability for Pop Pop to teleport to/from his shop/house, to make Pop Pop's questline smoother
 New quest to unlock Wine recipe in Kazai Village
 Lots of fixes!


🤖 Nav Mesh Generation Rework
We've fully reworked how the nav mesh generates, to account for several cases in which the shop nav mesh could be destroyed. Customers and employees should get stuck much less frequently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/06b2f202adbb9085a82d11fc71ba82eba45375b2.gif

Please be aware that the first time you load your shop will take a bit longer to convert your previous shop nav mesh.

If you still experience issues, check out the ESC -> Help menu to manually regenerate your shop's nav mesh and please leave us feedback on the Steam forums or https://discord.gg/Saleblazers.


👴🏻Teleporting Pop Pop and Condensing Pop Pop's Quest
We've heard a lot of feedback from players on our Steam reviews and forums that completing Pop Pop's quest may be too tedious because his house is so far away.

In addition to the existing option of teleporting yourself to the Totem near his house, you now have the option to teleport Pop Pop to his house or shop by talking to him! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/3b73155d33c72d710f63d7269e2c6ddbbebf1b25.png

We've also made a few changes to condense Pop Pop's questline. There's still the same amount of content, but you shouldn't have to waste as much time going back and forth. 

We really want players to complete his quest as fast as possible, since we believe the true Saleblazers experience unlocks once you've ventured out of the starting area!

🎒 Inventory Save/Load Rework
There isn't much to show here, but we've reworked a lot of the backend of loading inventory data. It should run faster and be more stable now.

notes.title: Update 0.1017 - Building Snapping, Nav Mesh Polish, and More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/33169c087845d9270048c6c47ec0e4e154625cbb.png
📜 Update 0.1017 Summary
In 0.1017 we focused on improving building snapping and customer AI aspects of shopkeeping. Here are key takeaways of this patch:

 🏗️ Better building snapping
 🤖 Better nav mesh cuts on buildings (this will improve customer pathfinding)
 ⭐ Quality of life and polish improvements
 ⚔️ Quest polish
 ⚙️ Snowville optimizations
 ⚙️ General CPU optimizations
 🛠️ Overall stability, especially between host and clients

🎈 Extra: Dialogue Mouth Animations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/afc89d3085cf7ffcbcb728275234fc6e3aa5bd7f.gif

We'll start off this patch with an extraneous addition: mouth animations during dialogue! 

This has been on the top of our personal wishlist for a while, so we quickly added this in before returning to focus firing on core needs of the game. Hopefully it will endear you more to the citizens of The Island! 

🏗️ Tweaks to Building Snapping
Door Snapping
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f4b54ac49b2e272e9e26e52408a561c84ff1c63e.gif
Snapping doors to door frames wasn't as intuitive as we wanted it to be, so we took some time to make this work better.

Better Edge Case Snapping
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a2bdceebb1cdfad502e4e829168b842751cd5d1c.gif

In this patch, you should also find it easier to build more edge case setups with multiple overlapping sockets.

Tip: if you want to forgo snapping entirely, you can hold down shift when building!

🤖 Better AI Navigation Mesh Cuts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5bc7bce428bb71323b1f7dfb87033335a7c4d398.png

We've done a pass over our building pieces to fine-tune how they affect the nav mesh.

Previously, some building pieces would either completely block customer pathing when it shouldn't (half walls underneath stairs), or fail to block customer pathing when it should (horizontal blocks).

Here are 2 examples of setups that now work properly.

Horizontal Beams Acting as Stanchions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0b0434bc8792ec0b2aaab54a38d51f6627288bb3.gif

A Crazy Layout with Horizontal and Diagonal Beams
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/90f3033e02cb2b8517a4e31eeacd7cf6b87991f9.gif

We are very grateful to everyone who sent in their save files on our Steam forums and https://discord.gg/Saleblazers. Accounting for all your interesting shop layouts allowed us to hone in on these fixes!

Important Shop Nav Mesh Fix
We've also located this weird case where certain items would cut small holes in the shop nav mesh. Over time, this can cause customers to get stuck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/89b59abad0e5745591e03014d9bcae80d9c01c61.gif

We already do an automatic refresh so you shouldn't have to do this, but if you're experiencing customers being stuck in certain areas of your shop please refresh the nav mesh by building and removing floor piece in the affected area.

notes.title: Patch 0.1013

🚱Major Memory Leaks Resolved
You should see significantly less usage of RAM, which should reduce crashes and increase FPS.

Our testers previously averaged 16GB+ RAM after just a few hours of gameplay. This number would continuously grow the longer you played, sometimes ballooning up to 30GB+ in particularly long play sessions.

Now, the same testers report a fluctuating amount of 7-9GB RAM usage, where memory will go up/down based on how heavy the areas are.

We will continue to bugfix and polish gameplay based on player feedback before moving on to new acts towards 1.0.

Quest Markers
In this patch we're introducing a brand new quest marker feature. Once you set a quest to be active via your Quest Journal (J), your map will display a large circle showing you an approximate area to investigate.

A massive issue we found was that when the game is played on certain languages (German, Chinese, French, and some others) the quest triggers would completely break. 

This should now be fixed, but we are extremely sorry for this issue. That would explain why most of our negative reviews are in these languages -- the game simply did not work. We deeply apologize for this error, and hope that you didn't feel duped in any way. Please let us know on the Steam forums or on https://discord.gg/Saleblazers if we still didn't fix it in your language.

notes.title: Patch 0.1002
notes.content:
Current priorities from highest to lowest:
[olist]
 Bugfixes
 Optimizations
 Design feedback
 New features
 More main quests, side quests, and systems
[/olist]

Apologies for needing this many patches at launch. We didn't expect there to be this many issues and are deeply sorry for any inconvenience caused. 

We're shifting priorities to making the start of the game smoother and stabilizing the build before moving back to working on new acts of the game. 

A big thing we want to communicate is that the game doesn't really start until after the initial Pop Pop quest, so we're looking into ways of expediting completion of that quest.

Changelog  

⭐New Features

 Added a quest NPC that will come to Pop Pop's Shop Plot to encourage players to explore the world (we'll be adding more soon if people like them)
 Aiming down sights at a customer will now make them fight or flee (we're prioritizing bugfixes right now, but we plan to add more onto this later)

notes.title: 9/26: Customer Needs, PVP Invasions, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello shopkeepers!

We've got a large patch for you all today, bringing several new features into the mix.

Customer Needs & Wallet Size
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257367/47e94e41ce3bd6ffeac9a64fb060889d5f2fcac3.png
Customer patience is now impacted by several needs:
[olist]
 Comfort
 Hunger
 Thirst
 Bladder
 Fun
[/olist]
If any of these dip too low, they'll start eating into the customer's patience. Make sure you put sufficient amounts of trash cans, toilets, chairs, food and drink in your shop! Needs are only in a basic state for now; we'll be refining how needs work over the next few months.

You'll also be able to see each customer's wallet size when you hover over them. Customers can't spend beyond this amount. Maybe it's time to invest in some ATMs...

PVP Invasions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257367/f1621d7a4801147ec318d121ec33000c2cd65491.png

PVP invasions are here, but are largely untested. Take your entire lobby to invade another server! Upon arrival, your team will target a single player on the other server. The invasion ends either when all of your lobby dies, the target dies, or one of your teammates strays too far from the target player.

To start an invasion, talk to the the mysterious traveler underneath the radio tower in the Steam Survival Fest map.

We've also made a lot of changes to shopkeeping to make progression feel much more satisfying in preparation for NPC employees. Let us know how it feels over at https://discord.gg/Saleblazers!

Outposts & Nighttime Enemy Spawns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257367/7db4233f948fd6ab63201b2ad6ec405d4a97d07d.png
We've added cowboy outposts throughout the Steam Survival Fest map as well as more variation and deadliness to enemy spawns at night.

Inventory Upgrades
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257367/655c9e1a314c0b802b4460d496a13a120e9d35e8.png

We weren't going to implement this in the playtest build, but it's been a very popular request. You can now upgrade your inventory slots at each of the NPC shops on the Steam Survival Fest island.

notes.title: New Combat Challenge Live! Also inventory saving, jump attacks, and item stats
notes.content:
Important: Please lower texture resolution or restart the game if you experience crashes / issues. We're working on it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257367/7b8631f278b04e4a86f9dc5e08474b062a4ea11f.png

We've created a brand new challenge, this time with solo AND duo rewards! There are deadlier enemies and a lot more attack moves for you to play around in this new patch.

Ronin Combat Challenge
Defeat our new wave within the least amount of time possible. This time around, we'll only reward the best score for separate solo + duo submissions instead of the top 3.

Deadline: June 10th
Submission Rules: Send a video of your playthrough with the in-game wave timer clearly visible at all times. 

Submit a link in our #challenge-submissions channel on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Saleblazers

For lone wolf players.

Bring a friend and achieve quicker results!
Reward: $30 Amazon Gift Card [2x]

Good luck, and have fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2d64449f81797c59ecfc55323790ff9f15a24c51.png

Progress Update

Jump Attacks
Most, if not all, weapons now have jump attacks. This'll add some more mobility to your gameplay, similar to the katana charge move. Let us know how it feels!

Player Inventory Saving and Loading
Inventories, equipment, and money are now saved to each character! Let us know if there are any issues! We definitely don't want anyone's save files to break in Early Access, so any save/load issues would be highly appreciated.

In the full game, we're planning to have a persistent player inventory that's tied to the character. Other things like personal skill trees and mastery levels will also be saved. We've had this system on our end for a while, but this is the first time we're pushing out some semblance of saving/loading to the public. 

Item Attributes
We're also testing out our item attributes for the first time. They won't be save/loaded properly yet, because we're still fleshing them out.

In the full version of Saleblazers, we're imagining a large variety of item attributes that are applied differently -- some on hit, on wear, on equip, on consume. We have a personal skill tree that allows you to make unique builds, but our vision for the game is to have the clothing & items define your playstyle. Healers wear chef hats, tanks don riot gear, and gunslingers will be decked out in cool robes. Clothes that offer damage bonuses give no HP, and vice versa.

The first 3 attributes we'll be pushing out are HP, armor, and movement speed attributes. For now in the playtest build, they can be found by looting enemies in the enemy spawner area. Next up, we'll add damage and healing modifiers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/759849e38fde5b7e8d3c207a56351004d39a8e03.png

Future Updates

We're hard at work building & refining our shopkeeping systems in the open world map (not in the playtest build). We've also got a few more interns to help us polish up our tutorial level in the main story.

Being a systemic game, we've run into a lot of crazy situations. Here's an example of our customers accidentally punching each other in our store which caused district rangers to arrive:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f8969bef0eaec93291b9f9b4d552b48007bd2a0d.png

We're also working on bringing an open world building/survival mode to the playtest build, so stay tuned for that! Some of your buildings may make it into the main game as NPC shops.

New Additions:

- Added armor back to the game
- Player inventory is now persistent, meaning any clothes/items you equip will be carried over to future playthroughs

notes.title: Knockdowns, fishing, art updates, bugfixes, and a new bamboo katana!
notes.content:
Upcoming Patches:

 New combat challenge w/ prizes
 PVP Dedicated Server (similar to Rust) to test base-building, saving/loading, and any issues that may arise from a long play session


We need your help in playtesting a few new mechanics that we've added to the game!

Knockdowns
We've added knockdowns and knockup status effects to certain attacks. This should give more meaning to final hits of combo strings. Let us know if there are any crazy bugs with them. We've already squashed quite a lot of them on our own, but as always we need your help catching all of them.

Blocking/Parry Changes
We've noticed that players don't like blocking. It's probably because of how inconsistent blocking is. In this patch, we've introduced input buffering for blocking. If you just keep the block button held while being hitstunned, you'll enter the block state as soon as you are able to block. 

We've also introduced a chain-parry effect where you'll automatically parry any attacks within the next 0.5s if you keep the block button held. It'll be useful for dealing with our new buffed revolver enemies...

Intel Integrated Graphics Card Support + Graphics Options
We've heard people on Discord reporting higher GPU temps than average as well as crashing on bootup for integrated graphics cards. We've added a framerate limiter and options for turning off atmospheric fog + tesselation + foliage. That should help, especially for lower end machines! Performance on all machines is super important for us, so we'll be adding a potato graphics setting in the future. As a previous low-end gamer, I am here for all of you.

We're still working on making the game run better in general with CPU/GPU optimizations, so please let us know if your machine is having issues running the game. The open world will be more demanding than the duel map, but we're trying to hit a solid 100FPS for our minimum specs.

If you have an integrated AMD card, please join our Discord and help us fix your problem! https://discord.gg/Saleblazers

Fishing
It's still programmer art, but we've added our new fishing minigame to the game. Additional art is coming soon, but please try it out and give us gameplay feedback on the general direction of our fishing minigame!

New Bamboo Katana Weapon
We've added a new katana weapon in preparation for our upcoming combat challenge. It's great for players that love more agile gameplay.

Hit Detection Changes
We've added new lunge prediction that may or may not play better for PVP. There's also an extra hitbox that should help hit detection when whiffing due to low framerate. Bullet hitreg has also been improved in addition to increased bullet speed. Let us know if these changes are good!

We've also fixed an issue with our character materials and their normals. Check out how clean they look now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c7eb8b78cc2ae0b5554554bd7688e433fb85c0e5.png

Tune in next week for more updates! We're still hard at work on the main game, but we've still got some more cool things planned for the coming weeks. Here's a sneak peek of what you might have to face next week...
